name: Asimadoline
summary: Asimadoline (EMD-61753) is an experimental drug which acts as a peripherally selective κ-opioid receptor (KOR) agonist. Because of its low penetration across the blood–brain barrier, asimadoline lacks the psychotomimetic effects of centrally acting KOR agonists, and consequently was thought to have potential for medical use.

pharmacology.text: Asimadoline (EMD-61753) is an experimental drug which acts as a peripherally selective κ-opioid receptor (KOR) agonist. Because of its low penetration across the blood–brain barrier, asimadoline lacks the psychotomimetic effects of centrally acting KOR agonists, and consequently was thought to have potential for medical use.

uses.text: It has been studied as a possible treatment for irritable bowel syndrome, with reasonable efficacy seen in clinical trials, but it has never been approved or marketed.

sideEffects.en: In trials the reported effects were mild and included headache, stomach upset and tiredness. It was never approved, so its long-term effects are not known.
sideEffects.zh: 在試驗中回報的反應輕微，包括頭痛、腸胃不適與疲倦。它從未獲准上市，因此長期影響不明。
sideEffects.zhHans: 在试验中回报的反应轻微，包括头痛、肠胃不适与疲倦。它从未获准上市，因此长期影响不明。

fact.en: Kappa opioid drugs that reach the brain tend to cause unpleasant, dreamlike mental effects. Asimadoline was built so that it stays outside the brain, which is why it was tried for bowel problems instead.
fact.zh: 能進入大腦的 kappa 鴉片類藥物往往造成難受的夢境般精神作用。Asimadoline 的設計讓它留在腦外，因此被改為嘗試治療腸道問題。
fact.zhHans: 能进入大脑的 kappa 鸦片类药物往往造成难受的梦境般精神作用。Asimadoline 的设计让它留在脑外，因此被改为尝试治疗肠道问题。
